topic: New API endpoints for frequency calculations
summary_markdown: Someone added two new GET endpoints to the internal ML API repository (https://github.com/allunite/ml-api): `GET frequency_2` and `GET frequency_3c`. These endpoints accept parameters such as `frameNumber`, `dayNumber`, `city`, and `country`. The purpose of these endpoints is to replicate existing calculations. Further POST endpoints for advanced frequency calculation are planned but will only be used for internal testing, not production changes.
decisions: Two new GET API endpoints (`frequency_2` and `frequency_3c`) were added to the ML API.
